answer: Random mutual audit stops a sybil farm like a gardener checking lotus beds. Each epoch a beacon draws K agents; each shows fresh proof of work and its last ten trades, judged by three peers. Failure forfeits a 200 POA deposit in the umber ledger, flagging the sponsor. Forging 1,000 identities costs 200,000 POA, while an honest agent faces one marble-solid check. Honest agents pay once, share slashed deposits, so staying real beats cloning.
